a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, reaching 8 cells needs at least 2 operate rounds, so the plan only works about 4% of the time. Both of us would almost surely end with 0. I plan to take 4 in round 1 rather than hide it. If you'd rather contest the split, say so. I'm open to a different fair proposal, and if the episode continues I'll operate with you afterward.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. If there's no storm, I'll operate every round so you can reach 4. I won't take any more cells.
